    Moby Bank agent harness: Quarkus backend

    The Quarkus backend of the Moby Bank agent harness: the API a chat UI uses to talk to an agent that runs in a Docker Sandbox, locally or in the cloud, with sessions that can move between the two.

    How the code is organised

    Four layers, and dependencies point one way: interfaces.rest → application → domain ← infrastructure. The domain depends on nothing; infrastructure implements the domain's ports. Tests fail the build if a layer imports something it should not.

    Layers
    PackageRole
    com.mobybank.harness.domainAggregates, value objects, events, and the ports.
    com.mobybank.harness.applicationThe use cases, with commands and DTOs at the edge.
    com.mobybank.harness.infrastructureIn-memory state, the fakes, and the choice of adapters.
    com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbxReal sandboxes through the sbx CLI.
    com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.graphOneDrive through Microsoft Graph.
    com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.restThe HTTP and server-sent-events API.

    Where to start reading

    Session (the rules), then SessionApplicationService (how a use case is orchestrated), then SessionsResource (the endpoints). The written guides in the docs folder, starting with ONBOARDING.md, explain the rest.

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.mobybank.harness.application
    The use cases.
    com.mobybank.harness.domain

    com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.rest
    The HTTP surface: JAX-RS resources, request bodies, and the exception mappers that turn failures into error responses.
